# Nadzoring

> Nadzoring is a free and open-source command-line tool and 
Python library for network diagnostics, service availability 
monitoring, website block detection, and network analysis.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://alexeev-prog.github.io/nadzoring/main/source/quickstart.html): Installation and initial setup.
- [Command Reference](https://alexeev-prog.github.io/nadzoring/main/source/commands/all_commands.html): Available CLI commands and usage.
- [Python API Reference](https://alexeev-prog.github.io/nadzoring/main/source/api_examples.html): Python API documentation.
- [Examples](https://alexeev-prog.github.io/nadzoring/main/source/code_examples.html): Usage and code examples.

## Overview

Nadzoring provides network diagnostic and security utilities through 
both a command-line interface and a Python API. Its capabilities 
include DNS analysis, reverse DNS lookups, network diagnostics, 
security auditing, ARP monitoring, SSL/TLS certificate inspection, and subdomain discovery.

## Command Groups

- [DNS](https://alexeev-prog.github.io/nadzoring/main/source/commands/all_commands.html): DNS resolution, reverse lookups, health checks, tracing, comparison, poisoning detection, and monitoring.
- [Network](https://alexeev-prog.github.io/nadzoring/main/source/commands/all_commands.html): Network diagnostics including ping, HTTP probing, port scanning, WHOIS, traceroute, and routing.
- [Security](https://alexeev-prog.github.io/nadzoring/main/source/commands/all_commands.html): SSL/TLS, HTTP security headers, email security, subdomain discovery, and certificate monitoring.
- [ARP](https://alexeev-prog.github.io/nadzoring/main/source/commands/all_commands.html): ARP cache inspection, spoofing detection, and monitoring.
